text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I won! I can go toe to toe against those
two!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I never saw that coming... She
beat two
Mejiros...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't believe it... I thought for
sure one of
those two was going to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but next time, the
glory's
mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure McQueen feels just the
same! I know she's going to do her best
to live up to all your
expectations! And
that's not all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the
Mejiro family! And at the Takarazuka
Kinen, I, Mejiro
Ryan, will show you that
I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That's right! I'll always be
rooting for you,
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know if I could've said something
like that
after missing out on first
place...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Would I have the composure to think
about how my fans are reacting to my
performance, and how
to reassure
them?)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...No, there's no way. I wouldn't be able
to hide
my disappointment. That's the
difference
between Ryan and me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Those are the words of someone who's
lived
shouldering expectations.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
At the Takarazuka Kinen, that's gonna
be me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing in the winner's circle,
Ines Fujin
makes
this vow with her hand on her
chest.
